question: Does the author-profile list establish that the 2017 CvSU Cañas fish-and-crustacean thesis was presented at both 2017 PNEE and 2019 ISSAAS?

correction.priorTranscription: The 2026-10-26 review mistakenly attached the 2017 PNEE Camiling appearance to the Cañas fish-and-crustacean title.
correction.correctedFinding: The author profile lists the Cañas fish-and-crustacean title only under the ISSAAS Philippines National Congress and General Meeting 2019. Its separate 2017 PNEE paper is titled Environmental Assessment and Water Quality of Balsahan and Kay-Alamang Rivers of the Labac River System at Naic, Cavite, Philippines. The profile also lists a separate 2017 Cañas River plankton and water-quality poster.
correction.thesisRelationship: The 2019 presentation title is similar to, but not identical with, the official CvSU 2017 thesis title. The profile names Angelica T. Erce and A.M.A. Quiñones, whose names overlap the thesis authors, but no presentation abstract or proceedings copy was retrieved to establish that the presentation and thesis are the same work or contain identical data.
correction.confidence: High for what the profile itself lists; the relation between the 2019 presentation and the differently titled 2017 thesis remains unverified.

issaasJournalCheck.finding: The official Journal of ISSAAS Vol. 25 No. 2 (2019) two-page table of contents does not list the Cañas fish-and-crustacean title.
issaasJournalCheck.scopeLimit: This checks one journal issue only. It is not the full 2019 ISSAAS Philippines National Congress program or proceedings and cannot establish that the presentation or abstract was absent.

reviewedSources.title: Research and Extension - Amyel Dale L. Cero
reviewedSources.observed: The fish-and-crustacean title appears under ISSAAS Philippines National Congress and General Meeting 2019 (CvSU Indang, 19-21 November 2019). The 2017 PNEE paper is a distinct Balsahan/Kay-Alamang water-quality title; a distinct 2017 Cañas poster concerns plankton.

reviewedSources.title: J. ISSAAS Vol. 25, No. 2 (2019), Table of Contents
reviewedSources.observed: The contents list journal papers in this issue; the Cañas title is not among them. This is not a conference proceedings archive.

reviewedSources.title: Official CvSU ILS thesis catalog record and abstract/contents scan
reviewedSources.type: Primary institutional catalog and attached abstract/contents scan
reviewedSources.observed: Record 11186 identifies a May 2017 undergraduate thesis by Angelica T. Erce and Alyssa Mae A. Quiñones. Its 16-page scan reports 23 fish across 11 watershed stations but does not expose the species-summary table or site-to-taxon crosswalk.

reviewedSources.title: Freshwater Shrimp Diversity and its Correlation to Water Properties in Selected Sites of Cañas River in Cavite, Philippines
reviewedSources.observed: The bibliography cites the separate 2017 thesis; the article is not access to its fish table.

limitations: The author website is a secondary bibliographic source, not conference proceedings or a dataset.
No conference abstract, presentation file, full thesis, species table, methods pages, exact station coordinates or taxon-by-station crosswalk was retrieved.
The official 2019 ISSAAS journal contents are not the conference program/proceedings; not finding the title there is not evidence that the presentation did not occur.
The thesis aggregate is historical watershed-level context only; it cannot be converted into 23 named rows or attributed to a single Cañas reach.
Item-specific reuse terms remain unverified; no external access request was submitted.
nextAction: Seek authorized CvSU access to thesis pages 24-45 (methods, station table and species summary) and appendix figures on pages 80-85. Confirm independent-project eligibility and item-specific reuse before any request or use. Search the full 2019 congress program/proceedings only if publicly discoverable; do not infer absence from the journal table of contents.
